title: Minty.art
tagline: Minty is a community driven NFT marketplace with rewards on Polygon
description: We are a marketplace in beta built on Polygon. The platform is a working product with circa 500 artwork on sale and 50 creators on board. We are looking for devs capable to help us turn the platform into the LooksRare on Polygon. We would like to focus on some key features to get us closer to LooksRare model (staking, trading for WETH and token as rewards).
how_its_made: Polygon chain was our default Chain. We already had a minting and lazy minting solution. However by importing the existing ERC721 contracts, we had duplicated contracts. We used Firebase to bypass the issue.  To fetch data from existing NFT minted on Polygon, we used MoralisAPI. We also needed a more user friendly wallet so implemented Sequence.
